spans.s: नै—गम mf(ई)n. relating to the Veda or Vedic words or quotations (a N. given to the collection of 278 separate words occurring in the Nigama or Veda and commented on by Yāska; they are arranged in one chapter of three sections), Vedic, Nir.; BhP.
नै—गम m. an interpreter of the sacred writings, Pāṇ. v, 4, 118; Pat.
a way, means, expedient, MBh. xii, 3685
a trader, merchant, Yājñ.; MBh.; R. &c.
N. of an ancient teacher, Cat.
नै—गम—काण्ड m. or n. N. of the three chapters of the Nirukta where the Nigamas or Vedic words are explained by Yāska
नै—गम—गमिक mfn. relating to the Veda, Vedic, Kār. on Pāṇ. vii, 1, 1
नै—गुत॑ m. destroyer of enemies (or of Nigut), RV.
a form of Skanda (considered also as his son and play-fellow), MBh.; Suśr. (cf. next).
N. of a demon with the head of a ram (supposed to seize or injure children), AV. (cf. prec. and नेजमेष).
N. of a school of the Sāma-veda, Āryav.
